title: sMeltdown
description: Melt down tools and equipment to retrieve some spent materials.
body:
Random armour and equipment clogging up your chests and inventory? Recycle and reuse! sMeltdown allows you to throw those gold boots with barely any durability left on them into a furnace or blast furnace to get some return materials.

Blasting or smelting:
- Netherite pickaxe/axe/shovel/hoe/sword/helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots all return 1 netherite scrap.
- Diamond pickaxe/axe/hoe/sword/helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots/horse armour all return 1 diamond.
- Gold pickaxe/axe/hoe/sword/helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots/horse armour all return 1 diamond.
- Gold shovel returns 1 gold nugget.
- Chainmail helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots all return 1 chain.
- Iron pickaxe/axe/hoe/sword/helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots/horse armour all return 1 iron ingot.
- Iron shovel returns 1 iron nugget.
- Stone pickaxe/axe/hoe/sword all return 1 stone.
- Wood pickaxe/axe/hoe/sword all return 1 charcoal.
